tfn.s: Almost seven million foreign tourists visited Bali in 2025.
tfn.why: The text says: "Bali welcomed almost seven million international visitors in 2025, according to figures reported by Business Insider."

tfn.s: Some foreigners have been living in Bali for many years.
tfn.why: The text says: "Some international residents have lived in Bali for decades, built friendships and created businesses that employ local people."

tfn.s: Most Balinese people want fewer tourists on the island.
tfn.why: Not stated. The text does not say what most Balinese people think about the number of tourists.

tfn.s: All 342 people deported in early 2026 were social-media influencers.
tfn.why: The text says the opposite: "The figure does not mean they were all influencers."

tfn.s: Bali has banned all foreign investment in local businesses.
tfn.why: The text says Bali "has restricted new foreign investment applications in some small business categories", not all of them.

focus.note: Use but and however to show a difference, because for a reason and so for a result.

tfn.s: A free hotel stay in return for posts could count as commercial work even without payment.
tfn.why: The text says a tourist "may in effect be taking on commercial work, even if no cash changes hands."

tfn.s: The restrictions will be reviewed after two years.
tfn.why: Not stated. The text does not say whether or when the restrictions will be reviewed.

tfn.s: Supporters of the restrictions think local entrepreneurs should keep control of businesses they have traditionally run.
tfn.why: The text says supporters argue outsiders "should not be able to use their spending power to take over businesses that local people have traditionally operated."

tfn.s: Every foreign resident in Bali has behaved badly.
tfn.why: The text says the opposite: "Nevertheless, it would be unfair to judge every foreign resident by the actions of a few."

tfn.s: Most Balinese people support the new restrictions on foreign investment.
tfn.why: Not stated. The text gives the views of supporters and critics but not what most Balinese people think.

focus.note: Whereas compares two things, unless means if not, and despite is followed by a noun or an -ing form.

tfn.s: The figure of 342 deportations does not by itself show how many influencers were removed.
tfn.why: The text calls it "misleading to present them all as influencers", so the total says nothing about influencers alone.

tfn.s: The writer suggests that foreign creators have done nothing to benefit local businesses.
tfn.why: The text says "Foreign creators have helped restaurants and guesthouses reach international customers."

tfn.s: Officials plan to review the 18 restricted categories next year.
tfn.why: Not stated. The text does not mention any review of the restrictions.

tfn.s: Critics and supporters of the investment limits both worry about their effect on the local economy.
tfn.why: Critics fear the rules "discourage legitimate businesses", while supporters fear newcomers could "hollow out an economy".

tfn.s: The article says visa rules are already clear and fairly applied.
tfn.why: The text calls for "Transparent visa rules" and says the boundary between personal and commercial activity is not clearly defined.

speak.title: Role-play: a spare room for tourists
speak.setup: Work in pairs. Read your card, then have the conversation. Swap roles and do it again.

a.role: the neighbour who rents out a room
a.text: You rent a spare room to tourists and earn extra money. Your neighbour is unhappy about it. Explain why it helps you and what you will do to keep things calm.

b.text: Tourists are noisy and rents on your street are rising. Explain your worries, ask questions and try to agree on some rules.

phrases: I'd like to talk to you about the guests.
It's not easy for me to pay my bills.
I understand that, but the noise is a problem.
We're not trying to cause trouble.
Would you be willing to set some quiet hours?
Let's try it for a month and see.
speak.after: Afterwards, tell the class: did you agree on any rules, and are they fair to both neighbours?
